title: Make it easier for Distributions to customize pinned applications on taskmanager applet
line: Distributions can change the defaults of any widget, such as the Task Manager's pinned apps, with a plasma-<widget id>-defaultsrc file in the XDG config dirs.
explanation: Since the port to plasma_add_applet, applets such as the Task Manager compile main.xml into the plugin, so distributions can no longer patch or sed it to change defaults like the pinned apps and have to rebuild the package. KConfigLoader takes its default values only from the XML, and nothing let a distribution replace them. KConfigLoader (kconfig) gets new constructors that take a KConfigBase of overrides: while parsing, an entry whose group and key exist there uses that value instead of its <default>. Applet::configScheme() in libplasma passes it the plasma-<plugin id>-defaultsrc file from the XDG config dirs (e.g. /etc/xdg), so the distribution's value becomes the skeleton's own default for every applet.

commits.message:
KConfigLoader: allow overriding the defaults of the XML

Plasma applets compile their main.xml in, so distributions can't change
its defaults anymore. New constructors take a KConfigBase whose groups
and keys replace the <default> of the matching entries during parsing.

CCBUG: 511560

applet: let distributions override the defaults of main.xml

Applets now embed main.xml, so distributions can't patch it to change
defaults like the Task Manager's pinned apps. The groups and keys of a
plasma-<plugin id>-defaultsrc file in the XDG config dirs replace them.

BUG: 511560

media.caption: Pure master with plasma-org.kde.plasma.icontasks-defaultsrc and plasma-org.kde.plasma.taskmanager-defaultsrc ([General] launchers=Konsole, Dolphin, Info Center): a new top panel (Icons-only Task Manager + Task Manager) and the existing bottom panel still show System Settings, Discover, Files, Browser.
Same files and steps with the kconfig + libplasma fix: all three Task Managers show Konsole, Dolphin and Info Center.

review.text: The cross-repo design is very clean and places the default-override capability at the right layer in KConfigLoader (with good QDoc, ABI safety, and unit tests) while enabling distribution overrides for all Plasma applets in libplasma. However, the libplasma patch unconditionally calls the new \since 6.33 KConfigLoader constructor even though libplasma's CMakeLists.txt still declares KF6_MIN_VERSION 6.30, which will break builds against KF 6.30-6.32.
changes: In libplasma, either guard the new 3-argument KConfigLoader call in src/plasma/applet.cpp with `#include <kconfig_version.h>` and `#if KCONFIG_VERSION >= QT_VERSION_CHECK(6, 33, 0)` (falling back to the 2-argument constructor in `#else`), or bump `KF6_MIN_VERSION` to `6.33.0` in CMakeLists.txt.

reviews.text: The cross-repo design is very clean and places the default-override capability at the right layer in KConfigLoader (with good QDoc, ABI safety, and unit tests) while enabling distribution overrides for all Plasma applets in libplasma. However, the libplasma patch unconditionally calls the new \since 6.33 KConfigLoader constructor even though libplasma's CMakeLists.txt still declares KF6_MIN_VERSION 6.30, which will break builds against KF 6.30-6.32.
changes: In libplasma, either guard the new 3-argument KConfigLoader call in src/plasma/applet.cpp with `#include <kconfig_version.h>` and `#if KCONFIG_VERSION >= QT_VERSION_CHECK(6, 33, 0)` (falling back to the 2-argument constructor in `#else`), or bump `KF6_MIN_VERSION` to `6.33.0` in CMakeLists.txt.

reviews.text: The design is sound and in the right layers: KConfigLoader gains constructors taking a KConfigBase of default overrides applied before its own parsing (so lists and enums-by-name work), with an autotest, and Applet::configScheme() feeds it plasma-<plugin id>-defaultsrc from the XDG config dirs, giving distributions an ini-style knob like kicker-extra-favoritesrc for any applet, including the Task Manager launchers. Evidence covers new and existing panels, explicit user values winning, another applet (digital clock) and removal of the file; BUG/CCBUG split is right. But the libplasma commit uses the new \since 6.33 API while libplasma still declares KF6_MIN_VERSION 6.30.0, so as submitted it doesn't build against its declared minimum; the note acknowledges this but the patch doesn't do it.
changes: Raise KF6_MIN_VERSION to 6.33.0 in libplasma's CMakeLists.txt in the same commit (or guard the call with a KCONFIG_VERSION check), and state in the libplasma MR that it depends on the kconfig MR.
